chapter.title: Animals and Fishing
subtitle: Hens, cows, sheep, ducks, and one duck with a name.
Nella's rods, her bait, and the four fish she counts.

hover: Wool grows back. Mutton does not.
Biscuit came out of one of these.
A name and a colour, on a collar.
The reed village grows them in planters.
Nella hands you the first one.
It keeps the length you landed.

quests.title: Fence a Pen and Lead Two Animals In
quests.subtitle: They follow the wheat, not you.
description: Marnie: "Anything that eats will follow you. That is not affection, it is arithmetic."
Fence a square behind the barn, then bring in two animals on a &aLead&r, or hold &aWheat&r and walk slowly.
Two animals in a pen is a herd by autumn.

quests.title: Milk a Cow and Breed the Pair
quests.subtitle: The calf is grown by tomorrow.
description: Hold &aWheat&r near two grown cows and they pair off on their own.
Fill a &aMilk Bucket&r from either one. Milk clears any effect you are carrying, which is why Halden keeps a bucket by the still.

quests.title: Shear the Flock for Sixteen Wool
quests.subtitle: Wool grows back. Mutton does not.
description: &aShears&r take the fleece and leave the sheep standing. It grows back once they have eaten grass.
Dye a sheep before you shear it and every fleece off that animal comes back the same colour.
Act IV wants three blankets off this flock.

quests.title: Fill the Nesting Box With Sixteen Eggs
quests.subtitle: Hens lay whether you watch or not.
description: Pip: "They lay in the box if the box is dark. I checked. Forty times."
Keep three hens penned and pick up the &aEgg&r each one drops. &aWheat Seeds&r in your hand walk them anywhere.
Marnie took the first three: Act I, step 3.

quests.title: Gather Eight Duck Eggs
quests.subtitle: Biscuit came out of one of these.
description: Pip: "Biscuit is a duck. Biscuit is my duck. You are allowed to hold him."
Ducks nest in the reeds along the lake and drop a &aDuck Egg&r every few minutes. Throw one at the ground and sometimes a duckling walks out of it.
Duck eggs bake into anything a hen's egg does.

quests.title: Hive the Bees and Take Three Combs
quests.subtitle: Smoke first. They remember.
description: Put a &aBeehive&r within four blocks of flowers and the bees will find it themselves.
Light a &bcampfire&r under the hive before you shear the comb out, or the whole hive comes out with it.
Halden trades honey for stories and counts the jars.

quests.title: Tag a Pet and Give It a Bed
quests.subtitle: A name, a collar colour, and a place to sleep.
description: Tame a wolf with bones or a cat with raw fish, then put a &aCollar Tag&r on it to name it and set its collar colour.
A &aPet Bed&r heals it while it sleeps, and it walks back there on its own.
A tagged pet comes home. An untagged one wanders.

quests.title: Beat the Drum and Hang the Lantern
quests.subtitle: Follow, stay, wander. Pick one.
description: The &aDrum&r sets every pet in earshot to follow, stay or wander. Click it to cycle the three.
A &aWayward Lantern&r on a post calls a lost pet back to it from a long way off.
Pip lost Biscuit twice before Bram built him one.

quests.title: Build an &aIron Fishing Rod&r
quests.subtitle: Nella gives you one. Make the spare.
description: Nella: "The lake is not a mood. It is a timetable. Learn it, or bring a book."
An iron rod catches kinds a wooden one never sees, and the &bhooks&r and &bbait&r screw straight onto it.
She hands you her own at Act II, step 2.

quests.title: Build the Worm Farm and Dig Eight Worms
quests.subtitle: Bait beats patience.
description: Till grass with any hoe and &aWorms&r come up out of it. A &aWorm Farm&r fed dirt and bone meal makes them for you.
Put one on the hook before you cast. The bottom feeders, &bcarp&r and &bcatfish&r, barely bite without it.

quests.title: Land Four of the Lake's Named Fish
quests.subtitle: Bluegill, perch, catfish, carp.
description: Nella: "Four is not a competition. Six is a competition. We will get to six."
Cast off the pier for &aBluegill&r and &aPerch&r. &aCatfish&r and &aCarp&r sit on the bottom, so hook a worm first.
Three of them go on the inn wall in Act V.

quests.title: Fillet and Cook Eight Fish
quests.subtitle: Two fillets a fish, and no bones in them.
description: A &aFillet Knife&r turns any fish into two raw fillets. Small fish, big fish, the same two.
Cook them in a furnace, on a campfire, or in Marnie's skillet. Cooked fillets stack and travel.

rewards.title: Nella's Catch
rewards.description: Next: eight fillets salted into the granary in Act III, and three fish on the inn wall in Act V.

quests.title: Mount Two Fish on the Inn Wall
quests.subtitle: It keeps the length you landed it at.
description: An &aOak Fish Mount&r takes any fish you click onto it and holds it at the size it was caught.
Hang two in the inn's back room. Nella will say nothing about them, and she will look at them.

quests.title: Trade Two Toadstools From the Reeds
quests.subtitle: They pay in mushrooms and they mean it.
description: Wisp: "You bring bread, we bring the mushrooms that are good, not the ones that are also good."
Walk downstream to the reed village and trade for &aRed&r and &aBrown Toadstools&r. They grow in the boardwalk planters too.
First contact is Act II, step 1.
